harness.name: HalberdStrike

actors.name: BOSSAI operator
actors.note: lone operator; Acronis found no clear affiliation

harness.whatItDid: Mapped the attack surface across at least 20 projects, from a Taiwanese emergency-services portal to 50+ commercial sites, and passed its reports to other agents for exploitation. Over half its high and critical findings were false positives or misclassifications.

uses.quote: HalberdStrike was used across at least 20 distinct projects, from a single Taiwanese emergency-services portal to a batch of over 50 commercial websites, to map out the potential attack surface of various targets, resulting in pentesting reports that were then passed on to other agents for exploitation.
In one documented example, HalberdStrike scanned a Taiwanese emergency services target and generated a penetration-testing report documenting several misconfigurations.
